record_type_quote: Although the research generated by the expectancy-value framework has been largely correlational (Wigfield & Cambria, 2010), recent classroom studies reveal that interventions designed to enhance perceptions of value can increase both interest and course perfor- mance (e.g., Hulleman & Harackiewicz, 2009; Hulleman, Godes, Hendricks, & Harackiewicz, 2010). The research presented herein replicates and extends this prior work by further investigating a theory-based intervention designed to enhance student motivation and performance.
